body:
## Additive fresh PR325 certificate: 480 partner-mix retimings

The new sibling `research/gen5b-shared-kernels/p10-pr325-partner-retimings/` derives exactly 480 partner setup retimings, from rank 2 to rank 18, directly from immutable PR325 head `0eca9340a3df6141b8e71a41638c3937b3522888`. The resulting **conditional saving parameter κ is 0.000770612425424136**, improving the published paid892-presink value by 0.000000604335525339.

Credit: the replacement word and four new PR325 producer/data changes belong to DreamingOfClouds, with declared Anthropic Claude assistance. The acquired, hash-pinned original NOTICE preserves the detailed earlier contributions and assistance disclosures. The general retiming/descent mechanism remains credited to Rohan Arun's PR287 work and Anthropic Claude assistance. Our contribution is the fresh derivation of these 480 choices, independent complete source/local/global verification, fresh bank allocation, exact invoice and price, and portable packaging, with substantial OpenAI assistance. No old role/frame/chart or retiming-selection data is imported. Upstream programs are retained only as inert text.

The arbitrary-dirty argument explicitly separates address geometry from payload values. Rational address matrices induce permutations of complete F2-valued role arrays; ADD is pointwise XOR. The pinned common-array-frame theorem in `proof/primary/03-motifs.tex`, lines 146–185, applies after checking every common gate frame, exact edge quotient, fixed endpoint, unchanged logical scalar operator and complete COPY/transform/read/erase episode. These finite premises are independently verified on all 398,660 local records and 12,885 rational nondegenerate frames. The exact source/frame geometry includes all 480 changed setups, 960 source chains, 40,125 MOVE containments and 563,928 regular-source supports.

The global audit reconstructs all 119,604,000 mapped frame records, 300 namespaces, 720 phases, 960 route conjugacies and 100 positive copied-work overrides. Actual projector/conjugacy identities and negative-direction controls pass. All 2,430,000 role/replica/stage assignments fill complete banks, with no completion children. Two independent, equivalent endpoint-chart constructions need at most 139 and 141 factors, both within the unchanged 150-factor allowance.

The literal profile is stock 658,800; 14,514,000 children; rank mass 65,757,600; deficit 122,400; maximum rank 42 < 50. The finite coefficient is 24,857,617,667,871,401. Exact full-fallback pricing, all 47 strict assembly inequalities and rejection of the adjacent κ grid point pass. The portable aggregate has 40 regression tests and 28 compact receipts, with 21 bank and 12 emission negative controls. All 12,884 local basis-mutation controls reject. Thirty-two concrete artifacts match the independently frozen originals byte-for-byte.

The publication baseline is head `def71b9eb828aaa31d5e9602b6fc10ac9b844c12`, tree `04d58da0bcb5b9c51b31c6f431d820901e51464b`. All 354 previous contribution files remain unchanged. Immutable source acquisition and replay work from any working directory. Generated tables and streams are not committed.

All new finite gates are discharged conditionally. Production primitive/compiler realization, uniform eligible-prime and weighted routing interfaces, restored rows, ordinary leaves, complex/full-C, precision/recovery and analytic all-size hypotheses remain inherited. This is not an unconditional all-size theorem or an optimality claim. See the sibling README, proof, exact frame contract, provenance, independent adapter review and deterministic receipts for the precise scope.

## Separate paid-completion experiment

The paid 49+11 completion fills the remaining 60 arbitrary-dirty coordinates of one bank at each of five stages. The two complete cover sweeps occur after the 60 regular helper sweeps and before that stage's boundary. Their ten additional children are fully charged; no extra closure relation, free padding or fractional physical indexing is introduced.

The resulting conditional saving parameter κ is `0.000770003879871513`. The literal profile is stock 658,275, calls 15,002,710, rank mass 65,705,100 and deficit 122,400. The maximum rank remains strictly below 50. Independent exact calculations verify the full fallback moment and all 47 displayed assembly inequalities.

The new integration obligation is checked by concrete emission and independent artifact audits. The full-frame companion additionally reconstructs the actual final local frame word, screens all 133 reorder moves, checks all 15,034 used frames and maps 116,772,900 frame-tagged records through all 300 global namespaces. The source-geometry correction explicitly covers all 480 descended rank-18 setups and all 960 final source chains. Earlier supplementary source-chain language is limited to pre-descent geometry.

The finite evidence remains conditional on the inherited generic primitive compiler, uniform admissible-prime supply, complex/full-C supplier, precision/recovery, primitive and leaf constants, and analytic/all-size interfaces. It does not execute the upstream production compiler or assert an unconditional multiplication theorem. Upstream programs are only read as pinned inert text.

Run the portable aggregate from any working directory:

```sh
P10P_INPUTS=/path/to/source-cache \
P10P_OUTPUT=/path/to/fresh-output \
python /path/to/p10-paid-completion892/run_checks.py --check --tests
```

The portable replay passes 33 regression tests and freezes 31 deterministic receipt hashes. Source acquisition, exact authored dependency pins, compact matching and packing witnesses, and proof notes are included. Expanded tables and binary streams are regenerated in the output directory rather than committed.

Prepared with substantial OpenAI assistance. Existing contributor credits and Apache-2.0 notices are preserved; the new packet's `NOTICE.md` identifies inherited ideas and the source chain.

## Updated p10 baseline: weighted 890 reuse with all 1047 kernels retained

**Evidence boundary:** the original 133 raw record-number crossing proofs and retained transform/compiler, prime, complex-supplier, full-C and all-size interfaces remain explicit inherited hypotheses. The packet does not regenerate the complete final raw frame/record/hash pipeline, instantiate a numerical full-C/all-size cutoff or prove an unconditional multiplication theorem. ## Original pinned PR302 contribution

## Summary

Add a standalone verifier and construction note for 70 shared-donor rank-one kernel pivots, composed with pinned [PR300](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/300) and the 12-helper co-retiming from [PR301](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/301). A fully checked 72-pivot fallback and PR299-based arithmetic checkpoint are retained separately.

Under the retained source/compiler/all-size interfaces, the combined 70 case gives:

- Exact conditional kappa: `749940157923873/10^18 = 0.000749940157923873`.
- Bit coarse saving: `750502990558158/10^18`.
- Literal stock `1,229,560`; unreplicated calls `483,425`; rank mass `2,454,720`; deficit `4,400`.
- 70 pivots, 87 distinct donors, 157 affected helpers, and 601 setup/restore shear pairs.
- Displayed finite coefficient `90466979917115701 < 2^80`.
- Corrected sink-aware payload `12927738210344389271740351838400 < 2^104`, with strict positive gap `7354671393307281152206899447616`.

The separate 72-pivot fallback on PR300 plus co-retiming gives kappa `0.000749936120273400`, stock `1,229,555`, calls `483,455`, rank mass `2,454,710` and a 102-bit payload. The PR299-based 72 checkpoint gives `0.000749917402998347`. No global priority or optimality claim is made.

Comparisons here use the pinned older heads; newer upstream revisions exist, and this PR does not claim the best current bound.

## What is new

Pivots may share donors on the same rank-one entrance line. Pivot and donor sets remain disjoint, so the shear incidence matrix squares to zero and the setup/restore factors commute. Exact response relations, a reproduced common read cut and complete local frame paths certify the changed bit construction compositionally under the inherited decoder.

The packet includes independent role-to-bank allocation, not just inventory arithmetic: all 15,427 helper roles and all 60 replicas are assigned, totaling 925,620 assignments per stage and 4,628,100 across five disjoint stage namespaces. The 70 case uses 161,432 full width-120 banks per stage. Its 171 exact chart programs cover all 314 new role uses plus the 18 co-retiming endpoint programs, with at most 489 factors, within the retained 576/815 allowances.

PR300's 89 scalar events match original forward/old-kernel incidences; their 154 helper operands are disjoint from the broader 84-stream co-retiming closure and all new-kernel members. All 440 restoration and seven sink entries match PR299 semantically. Exact determinants additionally verify 65 distinct selected PR300 bases. The finite bill includes all 1,202 new scalar additions per stage and the actual sink redirects/mixed target paths.

## Immutable dependencies and diff scope

The change adds only `research/gen5b-shared-kernels/` against main:

- PR299 head `5f6bd3fbc0e6796dd31263cef1f06dc968186f64`, package `research/five-stage-gen5b-kernels-restorations-sinks`.
- PR300 head `fd516176fd068e4fa7af14b40cd878ce8c305296`, package `research/five-stage-gen5b-full` in `rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds`.
- The included co-retiming component is PR301 head `ebd6a08ed7d517387794c066490aa02aadcc78d4`, included locally for standalone reproduction.

Pending PR data is explicitly fetched using 16 immutable byte-count/SHA-256/Git-blob pins. A main checkout alone is not assumed to contain these inputs. This does not copy those pending PRs' upstream source bundles into the main diff, alter PR301, change PR294, or change main's selected certificate, production guards, `upstream/` or manuscript patch.

Only independently authored Python runs. The one fetched upstream `.py` file is read as inert loader-order text, never imported or executed. Large raw inputs and full generated scalar/chart/address tables are excluded from the committed files.

## Reproduction

Python 3.11+ standard library, with assertions enabled:

```sh
cd research/gen5b-shared-kernels
python3 -B fetch_inputs.py --destination /tmp/shared-kernel-inputs
export CORETIME_SOURCE_DIR=/tmp/shared-kernel-inputs
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s . -p 'test_*.py' -v
python3 -B run_checks.py --check
```

`run_checks.py --output-dir /tmp/shared-kernel-results --check` also generates complete factor programs and deterministic bank address tables; add `--write-streams` for the full co-retiming suffixes.

The aggregate checks include all 18,954 columns of the compositional bit identities; the full 55,985-event co-retiming suffix over F2/Z/absolute majorants in both directions; changed chronological frames; exact chart factors; complete role assignments; conservative finite/scalar bounds; exact moment brackets; three bootstrap steps; all 47 strict outer constraints and adjacent-grid rejection. Negative controls cover wrong response relations, missing setup/restoration, frame overlap, malformed arithmetic, omitted sink edges, changed source pins, chart/bank drift, duplicate roles and equality at the strict payload cap.

The final clean run passed all 135 distinct targeted tests on Python 3.12.14 in 280.020 seconds. All 27 committed JSON receipts were independently reproduced exactly as data by the portable aggregate from `/tmp`. Patch application and reconstructed-file hashes are also checked. Only independently authored verification code was executed.

## Evidence boundary

No additional open changed-stage obligation is identified by these checks. The original PR299 decoder, prefix/source admission and original row norms remain hypotheses. PR300's complete chronological/source-span admission is inherited: matching events, support and basis determinants do not reprove it. Unchanged chart/normalizer, cover, routing, prime, recovery, setup, finite-compiler, complex-supplier and analytic/all-size interfaces remain inherited too.

The shared-kernel all-column proof is compositional under the old decoder, not a literal replay of the entire upstream physical word. The bit interface stays F2; the stronger integer identity belongs to the co-retiming suffix only. The displayed finite coefficient does not set unspecified constants in `C_full` to zero. Upstream `make verify`, `make entrance-bank-verify`, complete physical admission and the full all-size theorem were not run. This is conditional research evidence, not formal verification of the multiplication theorem.
